card.name: Words after numbers in thresholds and references
card.fires_on: Small words and digits that follow a number or sit inside a numeric reference, such as 'times' after a number in 'x upper limit of normal' or the first digit of a section cite like (5.1).

modes.label: Times upper limit
modes.description: The word 'times' after a number in lab-threshold wording like 10 times ULN.
modes.example: muscle weakness or pain with a serum creatine kinase [CK] > 10<< times>> upper limit of normal [ULN])

modes.label: Section cross-reference digit
modes.description: The leading digit inside a parenthetical section citation.

modes.label: Space before dose numbers
modes.description: A space just before a dose figure in a list of doses.
modes.example: randomized to receive perampanel at doses of<< >>8 mg and 12 mg per

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like 'absolute' or 'relative' and away from unrelated words such as 'World' or 'mid'.
card.plain: It fires on the little words and digits right after a number when a label gives a lab limit, dose or section reference.
